title: A clone names the public GitHub copy as a fetch-only upstream remote, and every push to it is refused
goal: kb-setup asks whether the clone fetches from the public GitHub copy and, on yes, adds it as the remote git config kb.upstreamRemote names with its push url disabled; the pre-push hook refuses a push of any ref to the upstream remote or its url, sync and publish refuse it as a target; git.md and maintaining.md say the upstream is only fetched from

run: import re,sys;t=open('.claude/skills/kb-setup/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read();s=t.split('## 3. Commit hook')[1].split('## 4. MCP servers')[0];sys.exit(0 if 'kb.upstreamRemote' in s and re.search(r'fetch',s) else 1)
